verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a template gallery, community project remixing, or starting a Make file from an existing project instead of a blank prompt. Make kits, design-system imports, attached frames (docs-21) and reusable workflow instructions (docs-15) are adjacent context-supply features, not templates. Sharing a file with usage guidelines (docs-14) does not explicitly describe starting a new project from it.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt
